example_cases_2_3.theme_description: 【主体一：北欧风椅子】工业设计与网格的结合 (Nordic Chair)
example_cases_2_3.design_intent: 捕捉北欧曲木椅的有机曲线，将其作为纯粹的几何形体，与冷酷、笔直的瑞士无衬线字体产生强烈的形态对比。

environment_variables.FOCAL_IMAGE: high-contrast black and white objective photography of a minimalist Nordic bentwood chair, dramatic side profile, sharp focus, stark studio lighting, isolated on stark background (极简北欧曲木椅的高反差黑白客观摄影，极具戏剧性的侧面轮廓，锐利对焦，冷酷的影棚打光，从背景中孤立)

example_cases_2_3.compiled_prompt: High-contrast black and white objective photography of a minimalist Nordic bentwood chair, dramatic side profile, sharp focus, stark studio lighting, isolated on stark background. In the style of minimalist grid swiss typography poster. 'HOLZ' massive neo-grotesque sans-serif headline. Flush left typography contrasting with organic curves of the chair. Strict mathematical grid layout. Palette: high contrast monochrome, asphalt black, paper white, and a tiny typographic accent of swiss signal red. Massive negative space, asymmetrical layout. --no illustration, room interior, cozy, center alignment, decorative fonts, gradients, drop shadows --ar 2:3

example_cases_2_3.theme_description: 【主体二：古典雕塑】古典艺术的现代解构 (Classical Bust Sculpture)
example_cases_2_3.design_intent: 美术馆展览海报最爱的手法。用极端的微距和无情的边缘裁切来破坏石膏雕塑的完整性，打破古典的对称美，注入现代主义的理性。

example_cases_2_3.theme_description: 【主体四：枯树木】自然物体的建筑感 (Structural Winter Tree)
example_cases_2_3.design_intent: 将自然植物“去自然化”。不要绿意盎然的树木，而是像血管、像建筑裂痕一样的枯枝剪影，与直线排版形成一种近乎残酷的美感。

environment_variables.FOCAL_IMAGE: high-contrast black and white objective photography of a single bare winter tree branch silhouette reaching across the canvas like a fracture, structural and stark, architectural nature (一根光秃秃的冬季树枝剪影的高反差黑白客观摄影，像裂痕一样横穿画布，具有结构感和冷酷感，建筑般的自然)
